senses.gloss:
भूर् bhū́r, indec. [vc. of bhū, O earth], one 🞄of the tree vyāhṛtis in the formula bhū́r 🞄bhúvaḥ svâḥ, where it is taken to mean earth;
 🞄when fourteen earths are assumed it is the 🞄first of the ascending series of seven.

भुरण्य bhuraṇ-yá, den. P. (RV.) be restless 🞄or active;
 agitate (liquid).

भुरिज् bhur-íj, f. [moving backwards and 🞄forwards], du. scissors (V.);
 wheelwrightʼs 🞄vice (consisting of two arms which hold the 🞄wood while it is manipulated).

भूरुह् bhū-ruh, m. (springing from the 🞄earth), plant, tree;
 -ruha, m. id..
भूर्लोक bhūr-loka, m. world of earth.
